prompt: 寫一個 Bash 腳本，把資料夾裡所有 .log 檔壓縮起來，並解釋每一行。
answer:
我先建立腳本並用範例資料測試。


<invoke_tool>
Write: /tmp/tmpunhdsv78/compress_logs.sh
</invoke_tool>


<invoke_tool>
Bash: cd /tmp/tmpunhdsv78 && mkdir -p /tmp/claude-0/-tmp-tmpunhdsv78/7dcced1b-269c-54f1-b09a-b30a9e544490/scratchpad/test_logs && echo "error A" > /tmp/claude-0/-tmp-tmpunhdsv78/7dcced1b-269c-54f1-b09a-b30a9e544490/scratchpad/test_logs/a.log && echo "info B" > /tmp/claude-0/-tmp-tmpunhdsv78/7dcced1b-269c-54f1-b09a-b30a9e544490/scratchpad/test_logs/b.log && echo "keep" > /tmp/claude-0/-tmp-tmpunhdsv78/7dcced1b-269c-54f1-b09a-b30a9e544490/scratchpad/test_logs/c.txt && bash compress_logs.sh /tmp/claude-0/-tmp-tmpunhdsv78/7dcced1b-269c-54f1-b09a-b30a9e544490/scratchpad/test_logs /tmp/claude-0/-tmp-tmpunhdsv78/7dcced1b-269c-54f1-b09a-b30a9e544490/scratchpad/out.tar.gz && tar -tzf /tmp/claude-0/-tmp-tmpunhdsv78/7dcced1b-269c-54f1-b09a-b30a9e544490/scratchpad/out.tar.gz
</invoke_tool>
